'''James Sheldon''' received a Day 2 bye to the [[2005 World Championship]] at the [[2005 Endor Regional]] (23 October 2004).<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He finished second there behind [[John Hawkins]]; the two skipped the final confrontation and shared the first-place prize by designing a virtual card together.<ref name="pcf-3974-55367">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55367#55367 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55343%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In February 2004 he lived in Gig Harbor, Washington.<ref name="pcf-2668-40474">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40474#40474 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], Karrdeshark, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
